Keyword_Stealth.name: Stealth
Keyword_Stealth.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Stealthed{/u}{/b}{/c} characters cannot be directly targeted by enemies. Using an attack or taking damage will instantly remove {c_white}{b}{u}Stealth{/u}{/b}{/c}.

Keyword_Stationary.name: Stationary
Keyword_Stationary.desc: BUG THIS _ SHOULD NOT KEYWORD STATIONARY

Keyword_Bullnerable.name: Bullnerable
Keyword_Bullnerable.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Bullnerable{/c}{/u}{/b} creatures have 0% chance to Bellow when {c_important}Corralled{/c}.

Keyword_Chill_Frozen.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Chilled{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies have reduced Movement Speed. Repeatedly {c_important}{b}{u}Chilling{/u}{/b}{/c} an enemy will {c_important}{b}{u}Freeze{/u}{/b}{/c} it, preventing it from moving or attacking.

Keyword_Chill.name: Chill
Keyword_Chill.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Chilled{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies have reduced Movement Speed. Repeatedly {c_important}{b}{u}Chilling{/u}{/b}{/c} an enemy will {c_important}{b}{u}Freeze{/u}{/b}{/c} it.

Keyword_Hindered.name: Hindered
Keyword_Hindered.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Hindered{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies are able perform actions but are affected by Chill, Immobilize, Slow, Taunt, or Tether.

Keyword_Incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
Keyword_Incapacitated.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Incapacitated{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies cannot perform actions due to Daze, Fear, Frozen, Knockdown or Stun.

Keyword_Freeze.name: Frozen
Keyword_Freeze.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Frozen{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies cannot move or attack. Enemies can be {c_important}{b}{u}Frozen{/u}{/b}{/c} by repeatedly {c_important}{b}{u}Chilling{/u}{/b}{/c} them.

Keyword_Spirit_Fragment.desc: BUG THIS - POWERS SHOULD NOT KEYWORD SHADOW REALM

Keyword_Execute.name: Execute
Keyword_Execute.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Execute{/u}{/b}{/c} instantly kills enemies that fall below a certain percent of Life: 15% for Normal and 5% for Elite enemies.

Keyword_Berserk.name: Berserking
Keyword_Berserk.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Berserking{/u}{/b}{/c} grants [25|%x|] increased damage and [15|%x|] increased Movement Speed.

Keyword_Reload.name: Reload
Keyword_Reload.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Reload{/u}{/b}{/c} adds a slight delay in which a Skill cannot Cast again. Damage and {c_important}{b}{u}Reload{/u}{/b}{/c} speed for this Skill benefits from {c_number}[50|%|]{/c} of your Attack Speed Bonus.

Keyword_Unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
Keyword_Unstoppable.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/b}{/c} characters have all Control Impairing Effects removed and prevented.

Keyword_Weaken.name: Weaken
Keyword_Weaken.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Weakened{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies deal reduced damage: 20% for Normal enemies, 15% for Elites, and 10% for Bosses.

Keyword_Eviscerated.name: Eviscerate
Keyword_Eviscerated.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Eviscerating{/u}{/b}{/c} an enemy instantly damages them for 20% of their total Bleeding Life and then applies Bleeding damage over 12 seconds.

Keyword_Volatility.name: Volatility
Keyword_Volatility.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Volatility{/u}{/b}{/c} randomly empowers Hellfire Skills when you attack with them. Empowered skills deal [50|%|] increased damage on their next cast.

Keyword_Shadowform.name: Shadowform
Keyword_Shadowform.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/b}{/c} grants {c_important}{b}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/b}{/c} and any movement grants {c_important}{b}{u}Stealth{/u}{/b}{/c} but consumes stacks. Can hold up to 10 stacks.

Keyword_Demonform.name: Demonform
Keyword_Demonform.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Demonform{/u}{/b}{/c} increases your Maximum Life by [20|%|] and Demonology Skill damage by [30|+%|].

Keyword_Brimstone.name: Brimstone
Keyword_Brimstone.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/b}{/c} explodes if enemies remain near for 2 seconds, dealing Fire damage around it.

Keyword_Retain.name: Retain
Keyword_Retain.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Retain{/u}{/b}{/c} locks the resource spent on a skill for that skills duration, after which the resource is unlocked and restores as normal.

Keyword_Hex.name: Hex
Keyword_Hex.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Hex{/u}{/b}{/c} increases Abyss Skill damage taken by enemies up to [15|+%|] based on their missing Life. Stacks up to 3 times.

Keyword_Immune.name: Immune
Keyword_Immune.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Immune{/u}{/b}{/c} characters cannot be damaged and are {c_important}{b}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/b}{/c} with all Control Impairing Effects removed and prevented.

Keyword_Guardian.name: Resolve
Keyword_Guardian.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Resolve{/u}{/b}{/c} increases your Armor by [25|+%|] while active. {c_important}{b}{u}Resolve{/u}{/b}{/c} stores up to 8 charges, or 30 with additional bonuses. Taking direct damage removes a charge.

Keyword_PestilentSwarm.name: Pestilent Swarm
Keyword_PestilentSwarm.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/b}{/c} move quickly and deal Poison damage to enemies hit.

Keyword_SpiritFeather.name: Storm Feathers
Keyword_SpiritFeather.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/b}{/c} increase your Movement Speed by [20|%|] for 1 second when picked up, extended up to 16 seconds.

Keyword_Hunter.name: Ferocity
Keyword_Hunter.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/b}{/c} increases your Attack Speed by [5|%+|] per stack. This effect stacks up to 4 times and each lasts for 4 seconds.

Keyword_Fortify.name: Fortify
Keyword_Fortify.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Fortify{/u}{/b}{/c} is an additional reservoir of Life that is drained to heal you over time.

Keyword_Overpower.name: Overpower
Keyword_Overpower.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Overpower{/u}{/b}{/c} increases your Damage by [15|%+|] per stack. This effect stacks up to 4 times and each lasts for 4 seconds.

Keyword_Resource_Pickup.name: Crackling Energy
Keyword_Resource_Pickup.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/b}{/c} periodically damages surrounding enemies when picked up.

Keyword_Blood_Orb.name: Blood Orb
Keyword_Blood_Orb.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Blood Orbs{/u}{/b}{/c} Heal you for 15% of your Maximum Life when picked up.

Keyword_Healthy.name: Healthy
Keyword_Healthy.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Healthy{/u}{/b}{/c} characters have more than 80% of their Life.

Keyword_Barrier.name: Barrier
Keyword_Barrier.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Barriers{/u}{/b}{/c} absorb damage from all sources up to a specified amount and cannot exceed your Maximum Life.

Keyword_Daze.name: Daze
Keyword_Daze.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Dazed{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies cannot attack or use Skills but are still able to move.

Keyword_S02_VampCurse.name: Vampiric Curse
Keyword_S02_VampCurse.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Vampiric Cursed{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies grant a soul on death, up to {c_number}8{/c} stacks. Casting a {c_important}Defensive{/c}, {c_important}Macabre{/c}, or {c_important}Agility{/c} Skill unleashes all souls.

Keyword_Unhindered.name: Unhindered
Keyword_Unhindered.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/b}{/c} characters can move through enemies and their Movement Speed cannot be reduced.

Keyword_Ignited.name: Ignited
Keyword_Ignited.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Ignited{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies take [200|%x|]  extra Burning damage per source of Burning.

Keyword_Arbiter.name: Arbiter
Keyword_Arbiter.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Arbiter{/u}{/b}{/c} form grants [15|x%|] increased Movement Speed, Evade is replaced with an Angelic Leap, and Wing Strikes attack around you dealing [200|%|] damage.

Keyword_Retribution.name: Retribution
Keyword_Retribution.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Retribution{/u}{/b}{/c} is a chance for your Thorns to pulse around you when you Block. This damage counts as a {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skill.

Keyword_Judgement.name: Judgement
Keyword_Judgement.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Judgement{/u}{/b}{/c} marks an enemy for 3 seconds, dealing [80|%|] damage after it expires.

Keyword_Injured.name: Injured
Keyword_Injured.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Injured{/u}{/b}{/c} characters have less than 35% of their Life.

Skill_Primary_SubPower.name: Sub-Power
Skill_Primary_SubPower.nodeTip: {c_important}Sub-Power{/c} are Skills that can only be cast externally and cannot be cast directly.

Skill_Primary_Basic.name: Basic
Skill_Primary_Basic.nodeTip: {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills deal damage and are always available to cast

Skill_Primary_Core.name: Core
Skill_Primary_Core.nodeTip: {c_important}Core{/c} Skills spend Resource to deliver powerful attacks

Skill_Primary_Corpse.name: Corpse
Skill_Primary_Corpse.nodeTip: {c_important}Corpse{/c} Skills manipulate the deceased to torment your enemies

Skill_Primary_Focus.name: Focus
Skill_Primary_Focus.nodeTip: {c_important}Focus{/c} Skills concentrate your inner energy into power

Skill_Primary_Potency.name: Potency
Skill_Primary_Potency.nodeTip: {c_important}Potency{/c} Skills annihilate enemies with strong force

Skill_Primary_Curse.name: Curse
Skill_Primary_Curse.nodeTip: {c_important}Curse{/c} Skills afflict debilitating effects upon your foes

Skill_Primary_Conjuration.name: Conjuration
Skill_Primary_Conjuration.nodeTip: {c_important}Conjuration{/c} Skills summon Elemental entities to aid in battle

Skill_Primary_Macabre.name: Macabre
Skill_Primary_Macabre.nodeTip: {c_important}Macabre{/c} Skills control the battlefield and shield you from harm

Skill_Primary_Mastery.name: Mastery
Skill_Primary_Mastery.nodeTip: {c_important}Mastery{/c} Skills spend Mana to dominate the battlefield

Skill_Primary_Agility.name: Agility
Skill_Primary_Agility.nodeTip: {c_important}Agility{/c} Skills maneuver you across the battlefield with adept mobility

Skill_Primary_Imbuements.name: Imbuement
Skill_Primary_Imbuements.nodeTip: {c_important}Imbuement{/c} Skills infuse attacks with potent Elemental effects

Skill_Primary_Defensive.name: Defensive
Skill_Primary_Defensive.nodeTip: {c_important}Defensive{/c} Skills mitigate damage received and increase survivability

Skill_Primary_Brawling.name: Brawling
Skill_Primary_Brawling.nodeTip: {c_important}Brawling{/c} Skills reposition you or boost damage during a fight

Skill_Primary_Weapon_Mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
Skill_Primary_Weapon_Mastery.nodeTip: {c_important}Weapon Mastery{/c} Skills unleash powerful attacks that alter the battle

Skill_Primary_Ultimate.name: Ultimate
Skill_Primary_Ultimate.nodeTip: {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills shift the tide of battle and devastate your enemies

Skill_Primary_Wrath.name: Wrath
Skill_Primary_Wrath.nodeTip: {c_important}Wrath{/c} Skills unleash powerful effects that alter the battle

Skill_Primary_SoulShard.name: Soul Shard
Skill_Primary_SoulShard.nodeTip: {c_important}Soul Shard{/c} Skills bind demons from Hell

Skill_Primary_Companion.name: Companion
Skill_Primary_Companion.nodeTip: {c_important}Companion{/c} Skills summon allies from nature to aid you in battle

Skill_Primary_Subterfuge.name: Subterfuge
Skill_Primary_Subterfuge.nodeTip: {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skills outwit and debilitate enemies with trickery

Skill_Primary_Justice.name: Justice
Skill_Primary_Justice.nodeTip: {c_important}Justice{/c} Skills control the battlefield with the awesome power of the Light.

Skill_Primary_Valor.name: Valor
Skill_Primary_Valor.nodeTip: {c_important}Valor{/c} Skills strengthens your resolve and makes you an unstoppable force.

Skill_Primary_Aura.name: Aura
Skill_Primary_Aura.nodeTip: {c_important}Aura{/c} Skills passively help you and your allies.

Subpower_StunGrenades.name: Stun Grenade
Subpower_StunGrenades.desc: {c_important}{u}Stun Grenades{/u}{/c} explode after a delay, dealing Physical damage and Stunning enemies for {c_number}1{/c} second.

Subpower_IceSpike.name: Ice Spike
Subpower_IceSpike.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Ice Spikes{/u}{/b}{/c} explode after a short delay, dealing Cold damage and inflicting Chill.

Subpower_DruidDancingBolt.name: Dancing Bolt
Subpower_DruidDancingBolt.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Dancing Bolts{/u}{/b}{/c} skitter along the ground towards enemies dealing Lightning damage.

Keyword_Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Keyword_Earthquake.desc: {c_important}{u}Earthquakes{/u}{/c} deal Physical damage every 0.5 seconds over 4 seconds in an area.

Subpower_DesecratedGround.name: Desecrated Ground
Subpower_DesecratedGround.desc: {c_important}{u}Desecrated Ground{/c}{/u} lasts for {c_number}6{/c} seconds and deals damage over time to enemies in the area.

Keyword_IceSpikes.name: Ice Spike
Keyword_IceSpikes.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Ice Spikes{/u}{/b}{/c} explode after a short delay, dealing Cold damage and inflicting Chill.

Keyword_DustDevils.name: Dust Devil
Keyword_DustDevils.desc: {c_important}{u}Dust Devils{/u}{/c} travel along the ground and deal damage.

Subpower_Tectonic.name: Tectonic Spikes
Subpower_Tectonic.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Tectonic Spikes{/u}{/b}{/c} cause large spikes to erupt from the ground causing Physical damage to enemies.

Subpower_ArrowStorm.name: Arrow Storm
Subpower_ArrowStorm.desc: {c_important}{u}Arrow Storms{/u}{/c} rain down arrows for {c_number}3{/c} seconds, dealing Physical damage every {c_number}0.25{/c} seconds.

Keyword_Meteorite.name: Meteorite
Keyword_Meteorite.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Meteorites{/u}{/b}{/c} fall from the sky and crash into enemies dealing Fire damage.

Keyword_Empower.name: Empowered
Keyword_Empower.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Empowered{/u}{/b}{/c} skills cost no Resource to cast and gain additional effects.

Keyword_Vengeance.name: Vengeance
Keyword_Vengeance.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Vengeance{/u}{/b}{/c} deals 15% of your Thorns to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds.

Keyword_Doom.name: Doom
Keyword_Doom.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Doomed{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies accumulate 30% of Base damage done to them from all sources. {c_important}{b}{u}Doom{/u}{/b}{/c} expires after 3 seconds and deals all accumulated damage to the enemy.

Skill_Primary_Harmony.name: Harmony
Skill_Primary_Harmony.nodeTip: {c_important}Harmony{/c} Skills spend Resource over time to enhance yourself and make your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills free to cast.

Keyword_VolatileSkeleton.name: Volatile Skeleton
Keyword_VolatileSkeleton.desc: {c_important}{u}Volatile Skeletons{/c}{/u} explode around enemies, dealing damage and leaving behind a Corpse.

Keyword_SpiritStorm.name: Spirit Storm
Keyword_SpiritStorm.desc: {c_important}{u}Spirit Storms{/u}{/c} deal Sparking damage to enemies within and last for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

Keyword_IronShrapnel.name: Iron Shrapnel
Keyword_IronShrapnel.desc: {c_important}{u}Iron Shrapnel{/u}{/c} pierces enemies and deals Physical damage and Bleeding over 5 seconds.

Warplans_Pit_DifficultyTier.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Difficulty Tiers{/c}{/u}{/b} increases the Life, Damage, Experience, and Rewards of everything inside the Pit.

Warplans_Pit_GlyphUpgradeChance.desc: You have a chance to upgrade your {c_important}Glyphs{/c} at the end of a Pit run. The chance depends on the {c_important}Glyph's{/c} rank and the Pit's {c_important}{b}{u}Difficulty Tier{/c}{/u}{/b}.

Warplans_Pit_ProgressOrb.desc: Some enemies or objects may drop {c_important}{b}{u}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u}. Collecting them will grant bonus objective progress in the Pit.

Warplans_Pit_Guardian.desc: After slaying enough enemies, the Pit will spawn a {c_important}{b}{u}Guardian{/c}{/b}{/u} to ambush you. They must be slain to complete the Pit run.

Warplans_Whisper_Cache.desc: Collecting 10 {c_important}Grim Favors{/c} allows you to select a {c_important}{b}{u}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u} from the {c_important}Tree of Whispers{/c}.

Warplans_HelltideThreat.desc:
Slaying monsters while in Helltide increase your {c_important}{b}{u}Threat Level{/c}{/b}{/u}.

When reaching Maximum Threat, your Threat Bar will drain and powerful enemy monsters will ambush you.

Warplans_BossLair_HoardChest.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Hoard Chests{/b}{/c}{/u} appear after {c_important}Lair Boss{/c} is slain. You must provide a {c_important}Lair Boss Key{/c} to claim your Reward.

Warplans_MonsterPower.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/b}{/c}{/u} increases a Monster's Life, Damage, Experience, and Rewards.

Warplans_Pit_Seals.desc: Earn {c_important}{b}{u}Artificer's Stones{/c}{/u}{/b} in {c_important}The Pit{/c} after defeating the {c_important}Guardian{/c}.

Warplans_Mindcage.desc: A {c_important}{b}{u}Profane Mindcage{/c}{/b}{/u} allows you to increase the {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} of any monster in the overworld until you die.

Warplans_Cinders.desc:
{icon:Helltide_Currency, 2.5} Aberrant Cinders drop from slain monsters in Helltide. They are used to open {icon:Marker_Helltide_Chest, 2.5} Tortured Gift chests. 

If you die in Helltide, you lose 50% of your {icon:Helltide_Currency, 2.5} Aberrant Cinders.

Warplans_Obducite.desc:
Obducite is used by the {icon:Icon_Tooltip_Marker_Blacksmith, 1.5} {c_important}Blacksmith{/c} to
{icon:Crafting_Blacksmith_Masterworking, 1.5} {c_important}Masterwork{/c} equipment.

Warplans_Attunement.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Attunement{/c}{/b}{/u} determines your rewards at the end of The Undercity and is earned by slaying enemies near Beacons.

Warplans_PortalPrankster.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Portal Pranksters{/c}{/b}{/u} are rare Treasure Goblins that grant additional Rewards in Undercity.

Warplans_Tributes.desc: When entering the Undercity, you can offer a {c_important}{b}{u}Tribute{/c}{/b}{/u}. This will adjust the difficulty and the reward you can earn within the Undercity.

Warplans_Helltide_Hellwyrm.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Hellwyrms{/c}{/b}{/u} are massive demons that are attracted to players with a high {c_important}{b}{u}Threat Level{/c}{/b}{/u}. They emerge to spawn lesser enemies, but do not directly engage in combat.

Warplans_Whisper_Material_Cache.desc: Collecting 10 {c_important}Grim Favors{/c} allows you to select a {c_important}{b}{u}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u} from the {c_important}Tree of Whispers{/c}.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Human.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Human{/b}{/u}{/c} form grants {c_number}5{/c} Spirit per second and a {c_number}15|%|{/c} Cooldown Reduction.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Wolf.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Werewolf{/b}{/u}{/c} form grants a {c_number}15|%|]{/c} Movement Speed and {c_number}20|%|]{/c} Attack Speed bonus.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Bear.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Werebear{/b}{/u}{/c} form grants {c_number}15|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction and {c_number}20|%|]{/c} bonus to Maximum Life.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Versatile.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Versatile{/b}{/u}{/c} Skills may be cast in any form.
